results.title: Baaldo, una emergencia pop
results.overview: Baaldo is an emerging artist who is in the process of creating what will be the second album of his career. However, everything becomes complicated along the way when a health issue arises that may leave him unable to sing again.

results.title: Atonement
results.overview: In the early days of the Iraq War, a split-second decision made by a U.S. Marine during a tense standoff devastates an Iraqi family. Years later, aided by a New Yorker journalist, he seeks to reconcile with the family he destroyed.

results.title: Doing Life
results.overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

results.title: Red Beast
results.overview: Eetu Salin, a fiery working-class agitator and one of the founders of the Finnish Social Democratic Party, struggles not only with his childhood traumas and alcoholism but also against young radical socialists within the party who are vying for power. Eetu, who advocates for class struggle through peaceful means, joins forces with his friends Väinö Tanner and Yrjö Mäkelin to try to prevent the Finnish working class from being drawn into a violent revolution.

results.title: Bird in Hand
results.overview: A bride-to-be with a secret agenda returns to her hometown, using her wedding plans to manipulate everyone in her orbit.

results.title: Child
results.overview: With their young son running out of time, Anne and Greg are willing to sacrifice everything for one last chance to save him. But after crossing an unforgivable moral line, they find themselves trapped in a nightmare where every choice demands an even greater price.

results.title: Deadsight
results.overview: A cold-blooded contract killer known only as Deadsight executes without hesitation in order to clear his criminal record.

results.title: Secrets of the Southwest
results.overview: Discover the hidden stories Britain's southwest has to offer. From Foxes fighting on the streets of Bristol to Puffins looking for love on Skomer Island.

results.title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
results.original_title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
results.overview: Meet the inspiring individuals and communities who work to protect our most beloved UK wildlife.

results.title: Anbil Avan
results.overview: A married couple attempts to start a good life together, but unexpected trouble traps them in an unsettling situation that forces them to fight back for their survival.

results.title: Sigma

results.overview: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

results.title: Stranglehold
results.overview: Fed up with their lives, barely eking by in small-town Arkansas, a stripper with dreams and her Army vet husband decide to rob the strip club that employs her.

results.title: Nickels
results.overview: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

results.title: Orion
results.overview: A NASA interrogator is tasked with helping an amnesiac astronaut recover his memory in order to determine “who” or “what” killed the rest of the crew before they crash-landed back on Earth.

results.title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
results.original_title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
results.overview: In 2022, Salman Rushdie was preparing to deliver a lecture on the United States as a safe haven for writers when a man rushed the stage and, in 27 seconds, stabbed him 15 times. Airlifted to hospital, Rushdie survived, barely, and his wife Rachel Eliza Griffiths began filming immediately, capturing an unfiltered view of his recovery, return to life and how he regained his spirit and hope for the future.

results.title: Avaraachan & Sons
results.overview: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

results.title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
results.overview: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.
